description: aioelectricitymaps is a Python asynchronous client for Electricity Maps data. Its README gives pip installation and a zone query that returns recent carbon intensity, with package documentation for further requests. Users provide a service key, zone and time request; outputs are electricity-intensity responses at the provider's zone and time resolution. Geographic coverage follows Electricity Maps' supported zones, not every grid worldwide. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the client; provider API access and data terms are separate. A limitation is that carbon intensity reflects a published estimation method and is not a complete power-flow or dispatch model. The client can supply operational emissions context to electricity, charging or building simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model handles energy-system optimisation; no direct coupling was tested. No key, API response or package archive was downloaded.
name: aioelectricitymaps asynchronous API client
